_doc: LEXICON (Phase 051): the words for numbers and statuses, read by domains/lexicon.py. Each LEXICON_QUANTITIES entry is a band table (kind 'numeric': ordered bands with a `min` threshold, a `label` and a `phrase` per perspective; the first band starts at range[0] and each band runs to the next min, the last to range[1]) or a status table (kind 'status': a phrase per key, with 'unknown' as the fallback). Perspectives: 'self' is how the resident feels; 'other' is only what an observer could see. A quantity with no 'other' is hidden from others. Phrases never contain digits. A table with published false has no world read-off yet; its _doc says so. Edges that the pack or the world names are cross-checked by domains/lexicon_check.py; the others are APPROX (model choices, not sourced figures). INTENSITY_WORDS (numbers where 1.0 is normal; APPROX), AMOUNT_WORDS (numbers), VERB_ALIASES (verbs resolve to a canonical verb; a canonical verb maps to itself) and LEXICON_PAYLOAD (which observation fields are numeric or status words, and which band table words them, or why a field is not perceivable) complete the file.

energy._doc: ENERGY: the movement energy reserve, 0 to 100 (observation `energy`, which is body stamina_reserve x 100). Edges from EXHAUSTION (world/exhaustion.json, cross-checked by the self-test): 5 = e_collapse x 100 (below it a resident falls asleep where they stand), 15 = e_low x 100, 40 = e_mid x 100, 70 = e_high x 100 (full speed at 70 and above). 35 = the simple backend's rest_energy_threshold (bigville/backends/cheap.py, 35.0; a backend constant, not in the pack, so not cross-checked): 'flagging' is the band where that backend rests. The other perspective keeps the three bands an observer can judge (APPROX: a person reads a worn look, not a 5-point scale).

self.label: spent
self.phrase: about to fall where you stand

hunger._doc: HUNGER: the count of unmet meals, 0 to starve_limit (observation `hunger`). 1 = one unmet meal (the world adds 1.0 for each unmet meal, worlds/bigville_world.py). 2 = CARE.care_hunger_need and CARE.malnourished_hunger (world/care.json, cross-checked): an observer sees gauntness from there. 4 = CARE.starve_limit, the top of the range (cross-checked). 3 is APPROX, the midpoint of the top two bands.

health._doc: HEALTH VALUE: body health, 0 to 1, where 1 is fully healthy (body_state 'health'; ACTOR_DEFAULTS.body.health is 1.0). 0.5 = CARE.treat_health_base, the value assumed for a resident with none recorded (cross-checked). 0.25 and 0.75 are APPROX. Only the low bands show to an observer. The payload carries the status string instead (see health_status).

health_status._doc: HEALTH STATUS: the string `health` in the observation, whose keys are HEALTH_CONDITIONS (world/health_conditions.json, cross-checked). 'unknown' is the fallback for any other string. Each phrase is the resident's own words; the other perspective has only what an observer can see (APPROX: a limp, a fever flush, a thin frame). A chronic illness shows only as ailing; 'unknown' has no other phrase.

strength._doc: STRENGTH: effective strength, (str_base + str_train) x health (bigville_world.effective_strength). str_base starts at 1.0 (ACTOR_DEFAULTS.body.str_base), so 1.0 reads as ordinary. Edges 0.5, 0.9 and 1.3 are APPROX; the 0 to 2 range is APPROX (training and health move the value; no published distribution). An observer judges build, so the other perspective is visible.

stamina._doc: STAMINA CAPACITY: effective stamina, (sta_base + sta_train) x health (bigville_world.effective_stamina). The reserve is drawn from it (see energy). Edges and range as strength, APPROX. Self only: an observer cannot see a capacity.

mood._doc: MOOD: body mood, 0 to 1 (body_state 'mood'). 0.5 = ACTOR_DEFAULTS.body.mood, the starting value (cross-checked). Quartile edges are APPROX. An observer reads mood from the face and the stance.

intoxication._doc: INTOXICATION, 0 (sober) to 1. read-off not yet published: no world quantity exists until Phase 034. Edges APPROX. An observer sees a drunk person by their manner, so the other perspective is visible.

deficiency._doc: DEFICIENCY, a nutrient shortfall, 0 (none) to 1. read-off not yet published (Phase 035, nutrition). Edges APPROX. Self only: a watcher sees its effects only through health.

strain._doc: STRAIN, what work above the safe intensity leaves behind, 0 to 1 (Phase 050). read-off not yet published. Edges APPROX. An observer sees a strained body, so the other perspective is visible.

condition._doc: ITEM CONDITION, 1.0 (sound) down to 0.0 (ruined): held_items[].condition in the observation, and the world's condition attribute. Edges APPROX. These are generic words; the item's own class adjective (ADJECTIVES in world/adjectives.json: rusty, frayed, cracked) can refine them. Anyone can see the state of a thing.

quality._doc: ITEM QUALITY, 0 to 1 (the quality attribute on goods; water_sources.json uses 0.65 to 0.98). Edges APPROX. Anyone handling goods can judge them.

load._doc: LOAD, the carried weight over the carrying capacity, 0 to 3 (bigville_world.carry_state ratio). 1.0 = CARRYING.overload_ratio and 2.0 = CARRYING.drop_ratio (world/carrying.json, cross-checked): past drop_ratio the hand cannot keep the object. 0.5 and the top of the range 3.0 are APPROX.

chill._doc: CHILL, 0 (warm) to 1 (numb with cold). read-off not yet published: the weather is in the world, a body's chill is not. Edges APPROX. An observer sees shivering.

soaked._doc: SOAKED, how wet a person is from rain, 0 (dry) to 1. read-off not yet published (weather exposure). Edges APPROX. An observer sees a wet person.

skill._doc: SKILL LEVEL, 0 to 1, the trade skill (ACTOR_DEFAULTS.skill is 0.7 and the file calls the scale 0-1). Edges APPROX. Self only: a resident judges their own skill (self-assessment bias is out of scope). The phrases contain {what}: the caller names the skill or trade (describe(..., what='smithing')).

trade._doc: TRADE COMPETENCE: the same bands as skill, read against a named trade (describe('trade', v, what='smithing')).

hour._doc: HOUR OF DAY, 0 to 24 (observation calendar.hour; the clock runs from TIME.start_hour 6). Edges 5 and 21 = EXHAUSTION.night_end_hour and night_start_hour (world/exhaustion.json, cross-checked). 7, 12, 14 and 18 are APPROX: the day's blocks, until a sunrise and sunset model exists (Phase 042). Plain to everyone, so both perspectives share the words.

self.phrase: in the deep of the night

season._doc: SEASON: the key of SEASONS (world/seasons.json, cross-checked). Plain to everyone: both perspectives.

weather._doc: WEATHER: the key of WEATHER (world/weather.json, cross-checked). 'unknown' is the fallback. Plain to everyone: both perspectives.

light._doc: LIGHT, 0 (pitch dark) to 1 (full daylight). read-off not yet published (Phase 042, day, night and lamps). Edges APPROX. Plain to everyone: both perspectives.

distance._doc: DISTANCE in tiles (observation nearby_residents[].distance). The top of the range, 52, is FOUNDING_MAP.width (world/founding_map.json, cross-checked). Edges 2, 6, 15 and 30 are APPROX. Plain to everyone: both perspectives.

duration._doc: DURATION in minutes, 0 to one day. 15 = TIME.minutes_per_tick, one tick (cross-checked). 1440 = TIME.ticks_per_day x minutes_per_tick, one day (cross-checked). 60 (an hour) is a definition; 240 and 480 are APPROX. Plain to everyone: both perspectives.

amount._doc: AMOUNT, a count of things, 0 to 100 (the held-item quantity uses it). The edges are APPROX; the words are the ones AMOUNT_WORDS resolves back to numbers. Plain to everyone: both perspectives.

age._doc: AGE in years, 0 to 100. Every edge is a LIFE_STAGES age_min (world/life_stages.json: 4 child, 13 youth, 18 adult, 65 elder; cross-checked). Plain to everyone: both perspectives.

life_stage._doc: LIFE STAGE: the key of LIFE_STAGES (world/life_stages.json, cross-checked). Plain to everyone: both perspectives.

relationship_strength._doc: RELATIONSHIP STRENGTH: tie_strength, 0 to 10 (observation nearby_residents[].tie_strength). The edges 0.5, 1.5, 3 and 5 are the bond band codes of worlds/bigville_bond_world.py (_band_code: 2 acquaintance from 0.5, 3 friend from 1.5, 4 intimate from 3, 5 family from 5). That code is not in the pack, so the self-test cannot cross-check it. Its codes 0 and 1 (tie 0, and under 0.5) are one band here, 'stranger'. The top of the range, 10, is APPROX. Shared.

relationship_kind._doc: RELATIONSHIP KIND: the kind of a held tie. The keys cover the kinds in RELATIONSHIP_KINDS and RELATIONSHIP_DEFAULT (world's frames/relationship_kinds.json, cross-checked) and blood_kin and chosen (bigville_bond_world PRIORS). Self only: a resident knows what a tie means to them.

temperament._doc: TEMPERAMENT, -1 (sour) to 1 (sunny): FOUNDING_PERSONALITY.valence (population/founding_personality.json, cross-checked by key). The edges -0.33 and 0.33 are APPROX. Other sees a manner. read-off published by Phase 058 (the persona card).

trust._doc: TRUST in others, 0 to 1: FOUNDING_PERSONALITY.prior_others_trust. Edges APPROX. Self only. read-off published by Phase 058 (the persona card).

spite._doc: SPITE, 0 to 1: FOUNDING_PERSONALITY.w_spite (mean 0.15, cited there). The 0.15 edge is that mean; 0.4 and 0.7 are APPROX. Self only. read-off published by Phase 058 (the persona card).

charm._doc: CHARM, 0 to 1: FOUNDING_PERSONALITY.charm_weight. Edges APPROX. An observer sees charm in manner. read-off published by Phase 058 (the persona card).

outlook._doc: OUTLOOK, 0 to 1: FOUNDING_PERSONALITY.prior_world_safe, how safe a resident expects the world to be. Edges APPROX. Self only. read-off published by Phase 058 (the persona card).

finery._doc: FINERY of the clothes a person wears, 0 to 6: the sum of the garments' finery (ITEMS garments carry 1 or 2 each; the range and edges are APPROX). Other only: a resident does not judge their own finery from outside. read-off not yet published (the body's finery attribute is not in the observation).

day_block._doc: DAY BLOCK: what a resident is doing in the usual day. Phase 058 defines the blocks, so these keys are provisional. read-off published by Phase 058 (the persona card).

hostility._doc: HOSTILITY, 0 to 1: FOUNDING_PERSONALITY.hostile_weight (mean 0.4, sd 0.2, authored; no source, APPROX). Edges APPROX. An observer can see a quick temper. Published by Phase 058 (the persona card).

mood_bias._doc: MOOD BIAS: FOUNDING_PERSONALITY.mood_bias (mean 0.3, sd 0.2, unclipped in the founding draw; the range -1 to 1 here is a display range, APPROX). Edges APPROX. Self only: a resident knows their usual spirits. Published by Phase 058 (the persona card).

self_worth._doc: SELF-WORTH, 0 to 1: FOUNDING_PERSONALITY.prior_self_worth (mean 0.6, sd 0.2, authored). Edges APPROX. Self only. Published by Phase 058 (the persona card).

arousal._doc: AROUSAL, 0 to 1: FOUNDING_PERSONALITY.arousal (mean 0.4, sd 0.2, authored). Edges APPROX. Others can see it in a manner. Published by Phase 058 (the persona card).

role_identity._doc: ROLE IDENTITY, 0 to 1: how far a resident takes their trade for part of who they are. The cast draws it from FOUNDING_JOBS role_identity_mean and sd (identity attribute, not FOUNDING_PERSONALITY; edges APPROX). Self only. Published by Phase 058 (the persona card).

calendar.day.hidden: an engine calendar count; the resident reads the season and the weather

terrain_movement.*.*.hidden: a table of every terrain's multipliers, not a resident's view
